ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white interior covering approximately 85% of surface area; black perimeter mapping along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips; localized dark pixel cluster at the medial notch apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 75 degrees; vertical depth of notch is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; peaks and valleys occur every 10-25 pixels along the superior trailing edge boundary, isolated against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves on the trailing edges tapering to sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense black pixel clusters localized at both the left and right lateral fluke tips; smaller punctate black spots along the trailing edge serration peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical dark linear marks (rake marks) on the medial-right lobe; several faint diagonal linear disruptions on the upper-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive vertical rake marks on the inner right lobe; jagged, non-uniform tissue boundary at the central notch apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Small isolated dark focal spot located immediately adjacent to the right side of the medial notch.
